limitations: The audit perturbs only the 2.00x cadence because E72's non-equal jointly nonworsening result occurred only there.
It evaluates the E72 jointly nonworsening candidates and two negative controls rather than re-optimizing all 172 allocations on every grid.
Logarithmic phase and integer rounding are discrete implementation perturbations; request batching, delayed labels, and wall-clock scheduling can add further offsets.
Every grid remains preregistered and spends alpha by look index. Peeking or acting between its declared looks invalidates the guarantee.
All E68-E72 independence, expected-proportion, traffic-weighting, and detector-model limitations remain.
model: Perturb one logarithmic phase cycle of the 2.00x checkpoint schedule under ceil, nearest, and floor integer rounding. Re-evaluate the E72 jointly nonworsening splits plus certification/joint-average negative controls against an equal-alpha baseline on each unique grid.

validation.base_grid_reproduction: Every candidate allocation reproduces its E72 2.00x certification and drift summary.
validation.equal_control: Equal alpha has ratio one in every certification and drift case on every grid.
